column6: Worked: diagram commutes; ker f=ker g=0, ker h=coker f=coker g=coker h=Z/2; delta iso, coker f->coker g zero, coker g->coker h iso; exact at all six. OLD TEXT: Core Idea/Explainer list the homotopy LES of a fibration as an instance of the snake lemma on chain complexes; overstated (homotopy groups do not come from a chain-complex SES). Q3 explanation's "rows are SES of cycles and boundaries, vertical maps inclusion of boundaries into cycles" is garbled.

Worked: G=Z gives Z,0,Z/2; G=Z/2 gives Z/2 in all degrees; dual of Z -2-> Z -0-> Z gives Z,0,Z/2. OLD TEXT (clearly wrong, conflicts with this new How): Explainer para 4 says for a field G "both Tor and Ext vanish" and H_n(X;k)=H_n(X;Z) tensor k; false in characteristic p (Tor_1(Z/2,Z/2)=Ext(Z/2,Z/2)=Z/2, e.g. H^2(RP^2;Z/2)=Z/2). True only for characteristic 0. Para 5 repeats the error.
